beats.summary: Michael criticizes Pam's assessment of the egg-and-spoon race, emphasizing the importance of following rules.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Because he wasn't following the rules.

Michael: But they didn't complete their task, Pam! If people can't carry an egg in a spoon, blindfolded, then what does that tell you about how they will be able to manage a sales report, or conduct a business call?

beats.summary: Michael organizes a hot dog eating contest and encourages participants to eat quickly without mustard.

evidence.snippet: Michael: It's very important that you all try to eat as many hotdogs as you can…
Michael: No mustard! No mustard! Just… eat it. Eat it, Phyllis. Dip it in the water so it will slide down your gullet more easily.

beats.summary: The group makes a 'That's what she said!' joke during the hot dog contest.

evidence.snippet: Michael: No, no, no, no, not that— just… come on, you guys, let's do it!

beats.summary: Jim and Karen have a contest to see who can eat the most tuna salad, with Andy teasing Jim.
